name: Yaniv
summary: Israeli draw-and-discard rummy game where players aim for the lowest hand value to call Yaniv and avoid accumulating points.
rules_text: Each player is dealt 5 cards from a 54-card deck including jokers. Values: Ace=1, 2-10 face, J/Q/K=10, Joker=0. A draw pile and one upcard discard pile remain. On a turn you may discard: one card, two+ equal rank, or 3+ same-suit consecutive ranks with Ace low. After discarding you must draw one card: top of draw pile or only the first or last card of the previous set from discard. If draw pile empties, reshuffle discards except last play. At start of your turn if hand sum is below the Yaniv threshold (commonly 5-7) you may call Yaniv instead of playing. All hands are revealed. Lowest hand wins the round with 0. Others score their hand sum. If caller is not strictly lowest (Asaf), caller gets hand sum +30 penalty. Total score accumulates across rounds. A player exceeding 200 points is eliminated; last remaining or lowest total when first elimination occurs wins.
rating_reason: Draw-discard low-hand game, hidden hands, clear turn-based strategy.
